subject.title: No owner role on an org I created

question: Does production audit evidence confirm that `jasonacurry` created the `xerg` publisher and should receive its owner role?
rationale: Ownership restoration changes a privileged authorization boundary, and repository source alone cannot verify the claimant's production identity, creation event, or current membership history.

options.title: Audit and restore ownership
options.body: Verify the creation and identity records, restore the owner membership when they match, and investigate the write path for a reproducible defect.

options.title: Request additional identity evidence
options.body: Keep the organization unchanged until staff can correlate the claimant with the creation event through additional account or audit evidence.

recommendation.title: Audit and restore ownership
recommendation.body: Verify the creation and identity records, restore the owner membership when they match, and investigate the write path for a reproducible defect.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the best available routing candidate from recent adjacent ClawHub Convex and release history, though direct ownership of the publisher subsystem is not established.
